title: Wonderful day in Granada, Spain
text: We had a wonderful day touring the Alhambra, Albaicin and Nasrid Palaces Tour. Our guide was very knowledgeable, accommodating and made for the best day in Granada, Spain. Couldn’t recommend this tour more!!
author: 665marnief

title: Antonio, our tour guide to the Alhambra in Granada
text: Antonio, the tour guide was fantastic!!! Very knowledgeable, easy to understand. Spoke multiple languages and was simply the best tour guide we have ever had. My wife and I ere very please and we feel we have a friend. We strongly recommend him
author: Pedro_S

title: Thank you Mr Sow!
text:
A big thank you to the guide Mr. Sow. He knew how to convey to us all the emotions behind the history of the Alhambra thanks to his knowledge and his passionate and exciting stories.

The tour was breathtaking, spectacular and the landscapes incredible.

Thank you again Mr Cheikh Sow for this magnificent visit.

Rita and Alexandre.
author: S4951YWritac

title: Best tour of Granada
text: This is the best way to learn about the 3 unique neighborhoods of Granada, the palaces, and gardens. Our guide, Jaimie, was very knowledgeable with perfect English, and a very nice person. We loved this tour!
author: SVETLANA_F

title: Breathtaking experience!
text: Truly remarkable experience. We visited the Alhambra in the morning and Albaicin in the evening. Perhaps would have been better to split into two separate days but due to our schedule,  one day was all we had left at Granada. The tour of the Alhambra was magnificent, full of breathtaking views,  knowledgeable tour guide Carlos and ample time to soak it all in. Three hour walk around the grounds sound like a lot but our guide kept a comfortable pace which aloud us to enjoy the experience without overburden. Luckily we had a few hours after the Alhambra to go get lunch,  go back to our hotel to
author: pedrorH9182JE

title: A 10/10 experience. To repeat with Edu totally
text: Eduardo (Edu) explained the visit with an overview that really brought me closer to the time, and all in a rigorous but entertaining way. Three o'clock was too fast.
author: Mavalife

title: Magnificent
text: The palace interior is magnificent with rich details on walls and roofs I visited many places around the world but this kind of archicture is unique you can't find it elsewhere.
author: 325samer

title: Visit Alhambra and Albaicin group 14 people
text:
Excellent guide Nina.Very nice visit, interesting and in very good French.Rhythm well adapted.We highly recommend this complete visit and this girl guide.
PS: better indicate the 2h break between the two visits , from the booking!
author: Footprints507711

title: Visit of the Alhambra
text: A visit with our guide Marco Antonio, motivated as ever that made us live a moment of happiness... With impeccable French, dynamism and a touch of humour he took us back in time and discovered the secrets of the Alhambra... Thank you again and see you soon...
author: EVOLUTIONARBUSIGNY

title: A magnificent visit
text:
Lucia has been with us for almost 6 hours.

I think he has very good knowledge of monuments and explains the technical aspects and legends with great grace.

He is rating that he loves his job and passes on his knowledge to the people he serves.

Very good choice
